verdict.rationale: Lever documents a dedicated Integrator Sandbox with its own API base, its own auth server and separate per-environment apps, which isolates testing from production data. However, access is partner/integrator-gated rather than self-serve, and the evidence is a single first-party docs source. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox access for ordinary users, documentation of sandbox data seeding/reset behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: While you are building you will use your Lever Integrator Sandbox account
Callback URLs can be unique to sandbox and production. You will have two separate app's, one for each environment
